Case reference: 2016052751.CaseDesc: On August 4, 2016, Suchand Reddy Pingli was seen for the last time at his apartment in the Le Plateau-Mont-Royal District of Montreal, Quebec. Suchand suffers from health problems and has to take medication regularly. He is from India.

Case reference: 2016068711.CaseDesc: On September 30, 1969, an unidentified male was found 0.8 kilometres west of Sioux Lookout. His death appears to be self-inflicted

Case reference: 2013000099.CaseDesc: William Andersen and a co-worker were designated to conduct a wildlife survey in northern Manitoba. The men had flown into North Indian Lake on June 26th and departed by canoe from there. On the second day when the men attempted to shoot some rapids, their canoe hit a rock which overturned, throwing both men into the river. William was not seen again. Air and land searches failed to locate William and he is presumed dead as a result of drowning. No foul play is suspected in this matter.

Scar: 1" long scar 3/8" wide on the back of either the left or right hand.

Case reference: 2023044609.CaseDesc: Mathew Mangeya was last seen at 1:52 a.m. on July 13, 2023, leaving the University of Alberta Hospital Emergency Room with no known direction of travel. Mathew's whereabouts are currently unknown. No further sightings have been reported by anyone familiar to him.

Case reference: 2013000079.CaseDesc: Gilles Chiasson has been missing from Montreal, Quebec since April 18, 1995. Gilles took a taxi after a night out in a bar and was never seen again.

Case reference: 2012020165.CaseDesc: The remains of this male were found in a forested area immediately north of the Port Coquitlam cemetery.

Teeth: Visible Decay, Missing an upper front tooth on the left side prior to death. The upper front tooth on the right side was angled.
Deformity: Left Knee, Osgoode-Schlatter's disease - bony bump on shin below knee

Case reference: 2020011631.CaseDesc: On January 29, 1975, at approximately 8:30 am, Simon Wilson was seen for the last time as he left his home for school in Toronto, Ontario. Simon did not arrive at school.

Case reference: 2012020159.CaseDesc: In July 2004, the remains of an unidentified man were found on the shore of the Fraser River in Richmond, British Columbia. The man had good dental work and had a gold tooth in his left lower jaw. It is estimated that he may have died in 2003 or early 2004.

Case reference: 2012020170.CaseDesc: An adult male was washed up along the south side of the beach at Stanley Park, near the 2000 block of Beach Avenue at English Bay in Vancouver.

Wallet: Black, Contained pliers and a jack knife
Mark: Forehead, Post mortem abrasion on the right side of the forehead

Case reference: 2014006264.CaseDesc: William (Bill) Kwiatek was last seen in Canmore, Alberta, in July 1988. He was leaving a bar and had planned to hitchhike back to Calgary, but never made it there. In 2013, William was reported missing, but very few details are known about when he was last seen.

Amputation: Left Ring Finger, Partial missing finger

Case reference: 2010000299.CaseDesc: On September 3, 2009, Douglas Chong contacted his sister to inform her that he had attended the Toronto Western Hospital due to feeling unwell. He stated that he had been suffering from dehydration and was referred to Seaton House for recuperation. He allegedly stayed there for a period of three days, after which he was in a better state and then released. This communication represents the last known contact with Douglas. He has not returned to his last known address in Toronto, and neither hospital has any record of him attending on or around September 3, 2009. There has been no use of his health or bank cards since that date.

Case reference: 2013000088.CaseDesc: On February 19, 1973, Pierre Gariepy was seen for the last time in the Plateau-Mont-Royal district of Montreal, Quebec. Pierre is manic-depressive and was frequently hospitalized.

Case reference: 2014001632.CaseDesc: Elizabeth Dorion was last seen by a friend at a local fishing camp in Pukatawagan, Manitoba on September 21, 1999. She arrived at the fishing camp on September 17th with her friends and stayed there for approximately 4 days. She was never seen again. Searches of the area, including several steep embankments and the immediate vicinity of the camp, yielded no significant findings. Elizabeth's whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014002445.CaseDesc: On April 9, 1998, Elaine Dumba was reported missing from Coquitlam, British Columbia. However, Ms. Dumba’s family have not seen or heard from her since April 9, 1989.

Case reference: 2014003432.CaseDesc: On August 3, 1979, June Johnson was driven by a friend to the Marlboro Hotel in Prince Albert, Saskatchewan. We have not had any communication or sighting of June since that time.

Case reference: 2020017934.CaseDesc: On May 15, 2020, Lebohang Nicol was seen for the last time in the area of 600 University Avenue in Toronto, Ontario. Lebohang is also known to go by the first name of “Toby.” He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003388.CaseDesc: Janet Henry was a resident of Vancouver's downtown east side; she struggled with mental health and was engaged in a high risk lifestyle. Despite her challenges, Ms. Henry kept in frequent contact with her family. She was last seen on June 25, 1997, and was reported missing two days later.

Case reference: 2014006315.CaseDesc: Julia Strobach was last seen in her residence on Braidwood Road in Courtenay, British Columbia on October 31st, 2013 in the early evening hours.  Unfortunately, after a lengthy and comprehensive investigation police have been unable to find any trace of Julia.  Police along with Julia’s friends and family are gravely concerned for Julia's wellbeing as she has been out of contact for a year now.  It is completely out of character for Julia to be out of contact with her friends and family for so long, especially with her 3 year old son.  Julia’s red bicycle with yellow seat was also missing. Police are appealing to anyone with information about Julia's movements and activities in the days and weeks leading up to October 31st, 2013, to get in touch with investigators immediately.

Hair: Brown, Red, Dyed, Long, Often dyed red
Backpack: Metal, Red, Yellow, Julia’s red bicycle with yellow seat was also missing.

Case reference: 2005000899.CaseDesc: On April 21, 2005, a Caucasian male, believed to be between the ages of 29 and 50, was found in a wooded area on the embankment of a small creek off Queen Street in Bobcaygeon, Ontario. There are indications that this person suffered from early age-related osteoarthritis. It is believed that this individual had likely been at this location since 1994 or earlier.

Case reference: 2014003102.CaseDesc: On July 31, 1972, David Kyak was seen for the last time in Iqaluit, Nunavut.

Hat: Canvas, Blue, Ball cap, Polar bear crest

Case reference: 2025069051.CaseDesc: On December 16, 2025, Brian Auger was reported missing to Red Earth Creek RCMP in Alberta. There is concern from his family for his well-being, as he has not been adhering to his prescribed medication regimen.

Hair: Brown, Short, Short, dyed blond; goatee or beard
Tattoo: Right Wrist, A rose with text "KIRA"
Right Forearm, Cross with text "RIP DAVE B BOY 79-07"

Case reference: 2012030001.CaseDesc: In April 2011, both parents took their son, Aleksander to visit the mother's family in Poland. The father came back to Canada on his own on May 13, 2011. The mother, Elzbieta Nowacki and child did not return to Canada.

Case reference: 2006021199.CaseDesc: Guy Labreche and Ricky Dechaine were last seen at the airport in Sioux Lookout, Ontario on September 12 1987, as they departed on a return flight to Thunder Bay, Ontario. It is presumed that Guy, the aircraft pilot, lost control of his Cessna.

Case reference: 2014001277.CaseDesc: On July 26, 1987, Sukhminder Singh Grewal was last seen in Richmond, British Columbia. He came to Canada and performed as a singer in an East Indian Music Troupe that toured across the country. Sukhminder has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2021052226.CaseDesc: On January 28, 2016, at approximately 1:45 p.m., Daniel Leslie was last seen at Terrapin Point, on the American side of Niagara Falls, in Niagara Falls State Park, New York. During the time of his disappearance, Daniel was despondent.

Case reference: 2014004744.CaseDesc: Cyril Detimmerman and a friend left Brandon, Manitoba, on April 10, 1976 on the Assiniboine River to travel to Treherne. Cyril was experienced in navigating the river, but the water levels were very high due to spring flooding. The pair soon encountered strong currents and large amounts of debris in the river. While attempting to navigate to shore, the boat capsized, sending both men into the water. Both men were wearing life jackets. Extensive searches were conducted by land, air, water and dragging operations for several miles along the river, all with negative results. Cyril was never found and is presumed dead from drowning.

Case reference: 2013000019.CaseDesc: On December 18, 2001, Terrence "Terry" Sagal was last seen leaving his residence in South Regina, Alberta, at approximately 11:00 am. Prior to his departure, he withdrew $50.00 in cash and informed his wife that he was going to purchase gas, procure Scotch whisky, and visit the local Superstore. Shortly after leaving, Terry's Petro-Points card was used at the Albert South Petro Canada on a $26.00 purchase.

Case reference: 2025022621.CaseDesc: At 10:01 a.m., on May 2nd, 2025, Jack and Lilly Sullivan were reported missing from their rural home on Gairloch Road, in Lansdowne, Nova Scotia. Jack and Lilly’s mother reported the children had last been seen that morning at approximately 7:00 a.m. - 7:30 a.m., and were noticed missing from the house at approximately 9:40 a.m. Extensive search initiatives began immediately utilizing RCMP, GSAR, Air Services, Police Dog Services and drones but have yielded negative results thus far.

Case reference: 2016055037.CaseDesc: Human remains were found on May 10, 2006 in a field near Mossleigh, AB. They are believed to be those of a female, over the age of 40, possibly of Caucasian or Indigenous descent, who was between 5’2” and 5’6”. The individual was missing teeth and likely wore an upper denture. The individual may have complained of joint pain due to arthritis. The remains appear to have been there from 1 to 5 years.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Cheek, Healed fracture of right cheek bone
Mark: Right Side Of Head, Large button osteoma on right side of forehead

Case reference: 2024040404.CaseDesc: George Guilbeault was last seen leaving his home in North Cobalt (Haileybury), Ontario at approximately 8:30 pm on August 2, 2024 in his vehicle towing his boat.  The next morning, George's boat was found unattended on Lake Temiskaming, on the Quebec side of the lake.  Police found George's vehicle and empty boat trailer at the boat launch.  An extensive search effort by the Ontario Provincial Police and the Sûreté du Québec, including air and marine units and the OPP's Underwater Search and Recovery Unit, was conducted with no success.

Case reference: 2014006384.CaseDesc: On January 7, 2014, at approximately 12:20 a.m., Yinghui Zhu was seen for the last time at her family’s restaurant in Toronto, Ontario. Yinghui was supposed to open the restaurant the next day but did not show up.

Coat: Black, Winter, Winter jacket; Brand: Lacoste

Case reference: 2014001648.CaseDesc: On August 31, 1986, Gustave Focktave was seen for the last time when he left his home in the Côte-Des-Neiges-Notre-Dame-De-Grâce District of Montreal, Quebec. Gustave had left without his possessions and had left a farewell letter addressed to his family indicating that he would be hitchhiking to British Columbia to live in Vancouver. Gustave is originally from Madagascar.

Case reference: 2006019899.CaseDesc: Frank Uncapher was last seen on Lac Seul on October 21, 1974. He was on a hunting trip.

Case reference: 2024068145.CaseDesc: On December 11, 2024, David Hallam was reported missing to the Peace River RCMP. David was last seen on October 15, 2024 in the Queen Elizabeth Provincial Park on Cardinal Lake, near Grimshaw, Alberta. David is a freelance oil field worker with experience in Alberta, British Columbia and Ontario. His family are concerned for his wellbeing and are asking anyone who may have information regarding his whereabouts to come forward.

Hair: Brown, Short, Brown to salt and Pepper; stubble beard

Case reference: 2016034844.CaseDesc: On June 3, 2016, Derwin Beardy was seen for the last time in Winnipeg, Manitoba. During the time of his disappearance, Derwin was leading a transient lifestyle.

Shirt: Cotton, Red, White, Red t-shirt with white lettering across back, white emblem left chest

Case reference: 2014005149.CaseDesc: On May 21, 2008, Zelalem Assefa was last seen visiting relatives in Calgary, Alberta. Zelalem is from Ethiopia and had only been in Canada for about a year and a half when he disappeared.

Case reference: 2014006229.CaseDesc: In 1981, Cyril Thistle was seen for the last time when he was out on day parole and visiting his sister.  There is reason to believe that Cyril lived a transient lifestyle as he was known in Toronto, Ontario and on the west coast of Canada.

Case reference: 2008018199.CaseDesc: Carl Braum and Thomas Lumsden were last seen on the morning of May 19, 1974. They were travelling in a 14-foot fibreglass canoe in a northerly direction in the area of Depot Harbour, Wasauksing First Nation, Parry Sound District, Ontario. They were believed to be travelling to Killbear Provincial Park. There were no life jackets in the canoe.

Case reference: 2022032399.CaseDesc: On May 25, 2022, partial skeletal remains of this man were found in a forested area near Salmon Arm, British Columbia. He had a severe fracture to his right lower leg during life, which required surgical intervention. He likely died many months to years before his remains were found.

Foreign Object: Right Leg, fracture to right tibia with surgical implant

Case reference: 2013000049.CaseDesc: On May 9, 2008, Jean-Francois Rousseau was seen for the last time near the Mont-Tremblant National Park in Quebec.

Shirt: Blue, White, Plaid, dark and doubled
Scar: Forehead, vertical in the middle of the forehead

Case reference: 2012020147.CaseDesc: On March 25, 1996, the skeletal remains of a man were found near the Upper Levels Highway in West Vancouver, British Columbia. The man had recovered from severe injuries to his right arm and leg. He also had a fractured skull, nose and ribs. These injuries were likely a result of a single major accident. It is estimated that he may have died several months prior to the discovery of his remains.

Jacket: Corduroy, Purple, Lavender, Mauve, 3/4 length coat with fleece
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Side Of Head, Recent fracture to the left temporal bone above the left ear
Nose, Old nasal fracture with visible deformity
Deformity: Shoulders, Old injury; no indication of which shoulder

Case reference: 2006012599.CaseDesc: Ralph Grant was last seen in the Huntsville area between January 28 and February 22, 1999. He resided on Yearly Road, Huntsville.

Amputation: Lower jaw surgically removed due to cancer

Case reference: 2015020929.CaseDesc: On April 27, 2015, Andrzej Popek was last seen at the Crawford Lake Conservation Area in Milton, Ontario.  Andrzej's abandoned vehicle was located the following day in the Conservation's parking lot.

Case reference: 2014001521.CaseDesc: On November 3, 1972, a helicopter carrying a pilot and three passengers went missing in Lake Winnipeg. The helicopter left Thompson, Manitoba at 3:20 p.m. and was heading for Winnipeg after stopping at a number of communities. The helicopter landed at Warren's Landing at approximately 5:20 p.m., and left for Winnipeg. The pilot reported that the weather was poor and he estimated his arrival in Winnipeg at 8:00 p.m. At 5:50 p.m. there was radio contact with the pilot where he stated that he was over Poplar River. This was the last radio contact with this helicopter. The Canadian Air Search and Rescue, private aircraft and police aircraft searched until November 17, 1972 when the search was suspended until the spring of 1973. Nathan Kryger and Ian Fraser are presumed dead as a result of the helicopter crash. Foul play is not suspected.

Case reference: 2014004835.CaseDesc: Ashleigh Pettman was last seen on June 3 2005 in the downtown area of Kelowna, British Columbia. She had moved to Kelowna from Grand Prairie, Alberta in March 2005 to live with her grandmother. In May 2005, Ashleigh gathered her belongings and moved out of her grandmother's residence to an unknown location.

Case reference: 2012020082.CaseDesc: Katelyn Noble was last seen in the Radisson, SK district in mid August, 2007. Katelyn has had no contact with her family or friends in Mission, BC, and her whereabouts are unknown.

Case reference: 2025050099.CaseDesc: Perry Monias was reported missing to Lac La Biche RCMP in September 2025, as he was last seen on July 10, 2025 at Heart Lake First Nation, northeast of Lac La Biche, Alberta. Police and Perry's family are concerned for his welfare. He has no fixed address but has ties to Edmonton.

Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Cow skull with ribbon

Case reference: 2014005836.CaseDesc: On July 10, 2012, at approximately 3:30 P.M., Warfa Yusuf was seen for the last time in the area of Rossland Road and Harwood Avenue, in the Town of Ajax, Ontario. Warfa was observed entering a vehicle and was never seen or heard from since.

Mark: Left Ear, Birthmark behind left ear

Case reference: 2016066678.CaseDesc: On July 29, 1966, the remains of a male were recovered from the Maid of the Mist Landing, in Niagara Falls. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 175-180 lbs and his length was measured at 5'11", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.

Hair: Black, Short, Shorter than collar length, greying

Case reference: 2023068017.CaseDesc: Earl Moberg was last seen on December 12, 2023 at the family home in the River East District of Winnipeg, Manitoba. Earl suffers from dementia, and he has not been seen or heard from since.

Coat: Dark Blue, Green, Parka, dark blue or green

Case reference: 2014004137.CaseDesc: On the night of October 5, 1976, Jean-Luc Ringuette was seen for the last time when he left his home in Sainte-Anne-de-Madawaska, New Brunswick. The following morning, Jean-Luc did not attend school. A few weeks prior to his disappearance, he had disclosed that he had some money, and that he and a friend were going to leave town.

Case reference: 2012020093.CaseDesc: Garry Guenther left his home in Hepburn, Saskatchewan, on April 20, 2003. He was driving his white 1993 Ford F-150 truck bearing Saskatchewan licence plate GGG. Garry was reportedly seen in Hoey, Saskatchewan, on April 23 and 24, 2003. However, neither he nor his vehicle have been found.

Sweater: Cotton, Grey, Sweatshirt with an image of a fish on the front
Deformity: Right Leg, Bow-legged, walks with noticeable limp

Case reference: 2014014065.CaseDesc: Ali Rizvi was last seen by his sister at a residence in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, on June 19th, 2014.

Case reference: 2014006175.CaseDesc: On July 8, 2013, at approximately 5:30 a.m., Jason Bathily and his twin sister, Clarene Bathily, were seen for the last time with their mother, Adelyne Mounga, in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014001638.CaseDesc: On November 18, 1977, at approximately 2:00 a.m., Norman Louison was last seen walking to a residence on the Cowessess First Nation near Broadview, Saskatchewan.

Case reference: 2014004703.CaseDesc: On August 13, 1995, Marie-Josée Boisjoli left her home in Laval, Quebec, mentioning that she was going to an appointment. The following day, Marie-Josée's vehicle and personal belongings were found at the family cottage, located in the Gélinas Lake area in Mont-Tremblant, Quebec. Marie-Josée has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2001002010.CaseDesc: Stephanie Cyr was last seen on June 5, 1998 at her home in Saint-Basile, New Brunswick.

Jacket: Green, orange and yellow plaid jacket
Skirt: Black and white stripped velvet skirt.

Case reference: 2014004294.CaseDesc: On May 28, 2001, Jean-Paul Leroux was seen for the last time when he left his spouse’s residence in Montreal, Quebec.  Jean-Paul's vehicle was located abandoned 7 days later in the parking lot of the Saint-Leonard shopping centre. Jean-Paul has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2015011636.CaseDesc: On June 20, 1998, a fisherman saw the body of a man floating in the St. Lawrence River in front of L'Île aux Vaches, Quebec.

Jewelry: Wood, rope around the neck with wooden cross
Socks: White, Grey, white top and grey on bottom
Tattoo: Right Shoulder, sword and a cross
Left Hand, Text "Ozzy", one letter on each finger

Case reference: 2010000198.CaseDesc: Timothy Mason left his residence in Welland, Ontario, on September 14, 2009, at approximately 8:30 am.  Timothy was known to be an avid walker, frequenting trails and off-road areas, and suffered from heart problems.

Hair: Black, Grey, Short, Salt and Pepper

Case reference: 2014004580.CaseDesc: On the morning of July 23, 1991, a group of 8 individuals left Igloolik, Nunavut and headed to Hall Beach, Nunavut.  The group travelled using a 24 foot freighter canoe powered by a 30 hp outboard motor.  It was a stormy day with heavy rain and approximately 24 km north of Hall Beach, the canoe hit ice, filled with water and capsized.  Only one occupant made it back to shore.

Case reference: 2013000010.CaseDesc: Jaime Wyatt was reported missing to the St-John's RCMP by family members that he had not been seen since November 12th, 1996. Jaime was a resident of Newfoundland and left the province in September 1996 to seek employment in Nova Scotia. The investigation revealed that Jaime stayed at the Twin Elms Motel on Inglis Street in Halifax, Nova Scotia and he was last seen there on November 16th, 1996. On the evening of November 16th, 1996, Jaime informed the staff at Twin Elms that he was going to be picked up to go to a dinner party that evening.  Jaime was never heard from or seen since that day and foul play is suspected.

Case reference: 2023030253.CaseDesc: Autumn Shaganash was last seen on June 10, 2023.  She has had no activity on her bank account, no money on her person, and no cellphone. Autumn, according to her immediate family, suffers from depression and anxiety and must take prescribed medication on a daily basis. She hasn't taken her medication since.

Case reference: 2014006470.CaseDesc: On June 4, 2001, Shahzad Ahmed was seen for the last time at his residence in Toronto, Ontario. Shahzad last contacted his mother by telephone to tell her that he had been fired from his job. During the course of their conversation, his mother had told him to return home to her apartment in Toronto, but he never arrived. The next telephone call that Shahzad’s mother received was from the Islamabad police in Pakistan, who had informed her that Shahzad’s luggage had been found unclaimed on the airport luggage carousel.

Case reference: 2012020050.CaseDesc: Shirley Lonethunder, a resident of White Bear First Nation near Carlyle, Saskatchewan, was reported missing from the downtown Saskatoon area on the afternoon of December 24, 1991.

Case reference: 2006012799.CaseDesc: John Crofts' last residence was a retirement home on Yearly Road in Huntsville, Ontario. The last confirmed sighting of John was on December 25, 1997 in the Huntsville area.

Case reference: 2014005030.CaseDesc: Wilfrid Langlois has been missing since February 5, 1998 from Port-Daniel-Gascons, Quebec. At the time of his disappearance, it is possible that Wilfrid was in the Chandler area of the Gaspé Peninsula, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014005682.CaseDesc: On September 27, 2011, Bernard Wierzba was seen for the last time as he swam with a friend near the Manola Bridge in Barrhead County, Alberta. During this time, Bernard was not wearing a life jacket and he has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2020050890.CaseDesc: On August 9, 2020, days after the death of her son, Audrey Beaver was seen for the last time in Edmonton, Alberta. That day, Audrey had told her family that she planned on setting up a tent to live in.

Case reference: 2014005716.CaseDesc: Maria MARIN left her personal belongings at Johnsons Lake near Wasa, British Columbia and was never seen again.

Case reference: 2006009499.CaseDesc: Frederick "Fred" Takerer was reported missing by his son on February 23, 2003. Due to physical limitations, he is unable to move around easily.  Police have been unable to locate Frederick, and their investigation is focused on the possibility that his disappearance is suspicious.

Case reference: 2018045820.CaseDesc: On November 7, 1994, at approximately 1:30 pm, Subarangit Rajanehru was last seen in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014001642.CaseDesc: In October 1983, Edna Smith was last seen at a camp with two other persons on East Trout Lake, located approximately 120 kilometres north of Prince Albert, Saskatchewan. A search operation successfully located the bodies of her two companions, but she herself remained unaccounted for. The boat that had been used by the three individuals was discovered capsized in the lake. It is suspected that all three individuals drowned.

Deformity: Mouth, Cleft Palate had been operated on

Case reference: 2012020095.CaseDesc: On February 21, 2006, between 8:00 and 8:30 am Draper Jim was dropped off on the road by the Health Center on the Saulteaux First Nation (North of Cochin, Saskatchewan). Draper was attempting to return home to the Witchekan First Nation and has not been seen since.

Scar: Lower Lip, Left side of lower lip
Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Ying Yang Symbol

Case reference: 2006017199.CaseDesc: Mistie Murray was last seen on May 31, 1995, in the Goderich area.

Teeth: Space between her two upper front teeth

Case reference: 2014004259.CaseDesc: Lorne De Silva – Piques was last seen on November 22, 2000, in the area of Niagara Falls, Ontario.  Lorne was feeling despondent at that time.

Case reference: 2014004742.CaseDesc: On January 9, 2006, Michael James Bosma left on foot from a care home located on Bernard Avenue in Kelowna, BC and failed to return.  Mr. Bosma had been diagnosed with schizophrenia and required essential medication.  ATM activity was recorded on his account during the night and early morning hours following his departure then all traces of him ceased.

Case reference: 2014032019.CaseDesc: On March 21, 1963, the dismembered remains of an unidentified man were found in burlap sacks on the side of the road near Pavilion, British Columbia. He had an old injury to his spine, likely causing pain and stooped posture, and was believed to have died a few months to years before being found.

Case reference: 2014004320.CaseDesc: On February 22, 2002, Alexandre Fortin was seen for the last time in a home situated on road 127 in Saint-Georges, Quebec. Over the course of the night, a fire completely destroyed the residence and Alexandre remains missing, despite search operations.

Case reference: 2014001540.CaseDesc: Marie Laliberté was a resident of east Vancouver who was engaged in a high risk lifestyle. She was last seen by her resource worker on January 1, 1997. Due to her increasingly sporadic contact with family and a lack of social interaction with others, she was not reported missing until March 8, 2002.

Case reference: 2014006038.CaseDesc: Kimberley Cruickshank was reported missing on March 25, 2013. She was last seen on March 22, 2013 in her apartment on the 2400 Block of Abbott Road in Regina, SK.

Hair: Brown, Red, Straight, Hair is shaved around sides and back with medium length section on the top
Pierce: Ears, 3 piercings on the right side and 1 on the left

Case reference: 2016069642.CaseDesc: On April 21, 1995, the remains of a woman were discovered near Carbon, Alberta. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 10 and 15 years. The individual had dental restorations including stainless steel crowns.

Case reference: 2025044624.CaseDesc: Ronald Kerling was last seen on June 5, 2023, at his residence in Cheektowaga, New York. It is reported that Ronald was feeling despondent at the time of his disappearance. Ronald’s cellphone was last used around the Upper Niagara River near the American Falls.

Hair: Black, Brown, Sports a full beard
Tattoo: Torso (Back), Jason's mask from the Friday the 13th movies
Left Upper Arm, Indigenous Person With Headdress
Right Upper Arm, Pit bull breed dog

Case reference: 2021008992.CaseDesc: On March 7, 2021, Konstantin Boukhanov travelled to Toronto, Ontario without telling his family. Konstantin has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2016059696.CaseDesc: On October 21, 2016, at approximately 1:00 a.m., Michelle Byron was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Coat: Other, WINTER, Dark coloured winter coat

Case reference: 2023067749.CaseDesc: On November 27, 1989, Thomas Nightengale was last seen in the area of the Upper Niagara River in Niagara Falls, New York, USA. Thomas was despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 1994001630.CaseDesc: On November 26, 1988, Amber Potts was seen for the last time in Etobicoke, Ontario. During the time of her disappearance, Amber was staying in a hotel room and was living a high-risk lifestyle. All her personal belongings were left in her hotel room.

Case reference: 2026000991.CaseDesc: On 2 August 2025, Nelson Boudreau and Gregory Landry set sail from Havre-Saint-Pierre, in Quebec, aboard a 24-foot Dorval boat, with the aim of fishing east of Havre-Saint-Pierre. The subsequent investigation revealed that debris from the boat had been found in the area between La Romaine and Chevery.

Tattoo: Back Of Neck, Tiger and Foliage

Case reference: 2014005505.CaseDesc: Forrest Schab was last seen on August 13th 2010 in Mexico City, Mexico.

Tattoo: Left Arm, Symbol of Rolls Royce
Left Upper Arm, Two aliens wearing suits
Right Arm, Upper arm, portrait of his sister

Case reference: 2014001072.CaseDesc: On July 19 1984, the body of a male believed to be between the ages of 18-29 was found in the waters of the Fraser River near Boston Bar, British Columbia. He had some crowding on his upper teeth and no tattoos or obvious scars. It is believed he was deceased for a few months prior to his remains being recovered.

Case reference: 2014005209.CaseDesc: On June 30, 1990, at approximately 10:15am, Cindy Clair was seen for the last time near 25 Martha Eaton Way in Toronto, Ontario. She told her roommate she was going for a walk and never returned.

Case reference: 2006011899.CaseDesc: Eric McKay was last seen outside "Clarkes Tavern" in Sioux Lookout, Ontario on December 22, 1987.

Case reference: 2014004602.CaseDesc: Denis Gelinas left his home in Notre-Dame-du-Mont-Carmel, Quebec on the morning of December 31, 1993 and was never seen again.

Tattoo: Right Arm, Snake and a dagger

Case reference: 2023012025.CaseDesc: On March 6th, 2023, Kimberly Jackson was last seen shortly after 12:00 pm in the area of Prospect Point, American Falls, in Niagara Falls, New York. At the time of her disappearance Kimberly was despondent.

Coat: Maroon, Black, Winter, Black fur around the hood.
Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Samurai skull with a knife

Case reference: 2008015499.CaseDesc: Sheryl Sheppard was last seen on January 2 1998, on Lundy's Lane in Niagara Falls, Ontario. An extensive investigation by the Hamilton Police Service was conducted but Sheryl has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005192.CaseDesc: In the late afternoon of May 12, 1980, Adjutor Lapointe was seen for the last time leaving his residence in his vehicle in Chicoutimi, Quebec. During this time, he was accompanied by an acquaintance.

Case reference: 2018023712.CaseDesc: On May 1, 2018, Elsa Vargas was last seen near her home in Chateauguay, Quebec.  Elsa's vehicle remained parked in the driveway but nobody was home.  Elsa has citizenship in Costa Rica and speaks Spanish, French and English and her disappearance is contradictory to her usual behaviour.

Mark: Right Cheek, Mole on the right side

Case reference: 2014005741.CaseDesc: Joseph Angus Morin had been living in Sturgeon Landing, Saskatchewan but left in December 2011, to take up residence in Wanless, MB. Joseph frequently traveled between the communities in the immediate area and was last seen in Cranberry Portage on or about January 25, 2012.

Case reference: 2007005499.CaseDesc: Lindsey Nicholls was 14 years old when she disappeared in 1993. She left the group home where she was living in the Comox Valley, BC at about 10:30 a.m. after having an argument with her foster mother. She was last seen walking away from the residence to visit some friends in Courtenay. She left all of her belongings and treasures in her room; she did not seem to be planning to run away.

Case reference: 2023011363.CaseDesc: Isabella (Rui) Dan was last seen around 8 p.m. on March 3, 2023. According to a witness, it is alleged she asked for a ride to an intersection thought to be in the Town of Markham, Ontario.
